profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | 🌟Accessibility Specialist CPACC | Counselor in training |Possibly a super hero 🦸🏾‍♀️ | definitely a mom | a bubbly ray of sunshine ☀️
profile.summary:
Hi! I'm Nicole Creshon-Davis, a passionate Senior Software Engineer from New Orleans, currently residing in Baton Rouge, LA. With a commitment to making technology inclusive for all, I specialize in creating accessible, user-friendly interfaces and am a proud IAAP Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies (CPACC) . I leverage that expertise in my role at iSeatz, where I ensure that digital experiences are accessible to everyone.

I have a passion for UI/UX and UX research and it allows me to help deliver exceptional digital experiences. My journey in tech began while attending a software engineering bootcamp. I then got my Associate's degree in Computer Science from Delgado. I have a Bachelor's of Science in Psychology. I will be going back to school to get my Master's on the summer of 2026.

Recognition is a part of my journey too. I was honored to be featured as a NOlAvate Black Tech 30 and nominated for the prestigious Ada Lovelace Award. These accolades affirm my commitment to excellence and innovation in the tech industry.

Outside of work, I'm a self-professed nerd with a deep love for Disney, especially Stitch and Princess and the Frog. Cooking is another passion of mine, and I find joy in crafting delightful dishes. I also enjoy writing, exploring new ideas, and continuously learning.

I'm always open to connecting with fellow professionals and enthusiasts. Let's collaborate and make technology more accessible and enjoyable for everyone!
